references.text: The Nazirite was to abstain from wine and strong drink, reflecting the same principle of temperance for those consecrated to God.
Ezekiel repeats the prohibition against priests drinking wine when they enter the inner court.
A warning to kings not to drink wine or strong drink, so that they do not forget the law and pervert justice.
Samson's mother was commanded not to drink wine or strong drink because her son was to be a Nazirite.
Reiteration of the prohibition against wine and strong drink in connection with Samson's birth.
The preceding context where Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire, which may possibly have been influenced by intoxication.
Paul requires that overseers not be given to much wine, reflecting the requirement for holy service.
Deacons also should not be addicted to much wine.
An overseer must not be given to much wine, in accordance with the requirements for those who serve God.
John the Baptist was to drink no wine or strong drink, as he was chosen for special service to the Lord.
